them.en: MiniMax Skills makes the agent do
them.zh: MiniMax Skills 让 agent 做

steps.en: Add the marketplace and install the bundle
Ask for the task in plain words, e.g. a native Android screen or a .docx report
steps.zh: 照常提需求，比如写个 Android 原生页面、出一份 .docx

steps.en: The matching skill's description fires and its SKILL.md is loaded into context
steps.zh: 描述匹配的 skill 被触发，它的 SKILL.md 读进上下文

steps.en: Follows the skill's checklist and reference files, e.g. getting the Gradle build green before writing features
steps.zh: 按 skill 的检查单和参考文档干活，如先让 Gradle 构建跑通

value.en: Domain recipes the agent would otherwise improvise arrive pre-written, across several harnesses
value.zh: agent 本来要临场发挥的领域做法，现成写好，几个 harness 都能用
